KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_VALENTES: Upgrade to the Deluxe Edition Bundle
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_ASTROLIT: This rooster’s helmet was built for space travel, but looks just as good dodging low ceilings and kitchen counters in the cantina.
The Astrolite is the most aerodynamic space traveler in the Rust Belt. White-water rapids are no problem for this cadet of both the sky and the seas.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_BEEKEEPE: If you listen close, you might hear a faint buzzing echoing from behind the Beekeeper’s veil.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_BOGWALKE: A lurker of the toxic swamps, the Bog Walker swims through ooze in style. This hazmat suit was once designed to filter out deadly fumes and poisonous liquids alike, but it has eroded into a high-visibility fashion statement.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_DEEPSEAB: This abyssal explorer plumbs the darkest trenches, feathers flared against the crushing deep.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_ENVOYSET: This oversized trunk is the perfect companion to a traveling wasteland musician. Pack your favorite dress shoes and your harmonica and play a lament by the roadside.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_FORESTRA: A watchful warden of the deep woods, the Forest Ranger moves like a sleek shadow between the trees. The same cannot be said for the rooster.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_GILDEDDR: Never in one place for too long, the Gilded Driftcoat moves like a shadow stitched in fabric.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_HIVEKEEP: Every bee in the hive is accounted for by this vigilant clucker.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_LEVIATHA: Only darkness lurks behind the grated helm of the Leviathan. This deep sea diver is an amalgam of fishing rope, sea urchins, nets and metal pieces from the farthest, darkest depths of the ocean.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_LUNASET_: Fighting ARC from zero-gravity, the Luna walks the Rust Belt as a relic of the future we were promised.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_MARCOSET: With an adventure rooster in tow, the Explorer treads toward uncharted horizons.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_MIRAGESE: A pilgrim of the wasteland, the Mirage dutifully carries the memories of the perished through the blistering sands of time.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_OMBRASET: The elusive Ombra moves like a coyote through the Rust Belt’s wilderness. A lone wolf with a hidden identity, if you ever see a glimpse of their face, you’ll know the end is near.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_RADIOMOU: The perfect backpack for a Rust Belt peak bagger, outfitted with an old radio transmitter and pager.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_RENEGADE: A suit found in the debris of a far-flung asteroid, the Renegade Moon is a patchwork of metals and fabrics that may or may not be approved for space exploration.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_RIOTSET_: The Riot is a perpetual protester. Always first to the fight, always last to leave.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_RIPOSTA_: The unseeable eyes of the Riposta are always watching your next move. Careful going toe-to-toe with this wilderness fencer, you might get sliced in two.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_ROGUEHAW: A renegade of the sky, the Rogue Hawk keeps a bird’s eye view of the battlegrounds.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_TRAILROO: This feather-footed wanderer treks the highest ridges and deepest woods, crowing proudly at every summit.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_TRAVELER: A clutch large enough to store your entire portable kitchen.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_VALENTES: The Valente is the Rust Belt’s very own wasteland cowboy. Legend says they can never back down from a duel, but you’d be foolish to test it.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_VELATISE: The Velati scout never misses an ARC signal.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_VOLTEDGE: The Voltedge is a human livewire. Before you shake hands, make sure to ground yourself.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_WILDERNE: With binoculars at the ready, the keen eyed Wilderness Scout is an indispensable part of the ARC resistance.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEFARME: A nutritional, farm-to-table diet is important for every growing Raider. While there aren’t really any farms in the Rust Belt anymore, this basket can sure make you feel like there are!
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEMEMOR: In the fast-changing wilderness of the Rust Belt, the mystical Memorialist is determined to keep the old ways alive.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEENGIN: A fixer, a builder, a breaker of limits. With a customized tool for every problem - even ones that don’t exist yet - the Engineer is at the ready to repair old and new world tech alike.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEGOALI: The last barrier, the immovable wall. On and off the field, this heavily padded protector will never go down without a fight.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THECAVAL: Living for speed and spectacle, the Cavalier rides into battle with style.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_GEARSHIF: Yearning for the roar of engines and the burn of asphalt, the Gearshifter is a stylish relic from the golden age of the racetrack.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_ANDROIDS: A body cobbled together from spare circuits and scavenged steel, the Torpedo clanks forward in defiance of obsolescence. Function isn’t guaranteed, but style is.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_MACRAMES: Luxurious in its maximalism, the Macrame is a testament to the boldness of its wearer.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_WELLSUMM: Dipped in ink, this rooster struts its glossy onyx feathers.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THETRAIL: A tech-savvy wanderer of wild terrain, the Trailbyte uses high-end gear and scavenged tech to chart paths long forgotten across the Rust Belt.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEJUNKY: A pragmatic scavenger of old aerospace yards, the Junkyard Astronaut sees treasure where others see trash.  Clad in a patchwork of astronaut armor and other relics of the old world, this suit is a testament to survival through ingenuity.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEMISTH: Stapling together disparate parts to create works of wearable art, the Misthorn turns survival into ceremony. Crowned with twin horns, their hand-forged attire speaks to the enduring history of the Rust Belt and the traditions that remain in the rubble.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEMOONS: A gorgeously pale show bird, the Moonstone Rooster never dirties a single feather.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEPASSE: Perfectly designed to fit in the Tubes’ upper compartments.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THECRAFT: Built for those who fix, tinker, and make things work again. With this toolbox backpack, a trusty tool bag, and a well-worn stapler, the Craftsman’s kit turns any mess into a work in progress.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEBEACH: This boat hook isn’t just for docking, it’s for defending your lunch. Paired with a picnic basket and a few lemons for luck, the Beachside Set keeps you ready for anything the tide throws your way.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_STOREBUNDLE_THEBONEC: Forged from animal bone and recycled cloth, the Bonecrown carries the wilderness as a mantle.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_THEFIEROSET_D: Even though the towers have long gone dark, survivors remain with an eye for the sky. Mapping forgotten air corridors and abandoned settlements, the Fiero holds out hope that someday wings will leave the ground in the Rust Belt again.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_THEABYSSSET_D: A relic of the first ARC skirmishes, the heavily armored suit of the Abyss was built to absorb the punishment of the machines. The scrying techno-eye stapled to the front of its helm might not be operational—but it’s certainly intimidating.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_THEDIVERSET_D: This scrapped-together oxygen tank might not get you to the bottom of the sea, but it’s good enough for a swim around the Red Lakes.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_THEHYDROLOGIS: The perfect backpack for a budding firefighter or a dedicated gardener.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_THESLUGGERSET: Once a regular in Speranza’s pickup games, the Slugger learned precision and timing by throwing baseballs across cracked diamonds. Those same instincts now guide every strike against the ARC.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_THESANDWALKER: The weather-beaten garments of a hardened nomad traveling from distant lands beyond the Belt, the Sandwalker commands attention and invites the intrigue of the locals.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_THEALPINERESC: As winter fast approaches, Raiders require a special toolset for handling the frost—a torch to illuminate the darkness, a rescue kit for fallen comrades, and a pickaxe for scaling hills.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_STEALTH_DESCR: For Raiders who strike and vanish. The Volare is hard to catch, and impossible to pin down. Slender lines and layered leathers let the wearer move swiftly and unpredictably in the Rust Belt.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_YARNFACE_DESC: Veiled in yarn, the Devotee’s presence unnerves even the boldest. The Devotee moves with singleminded purpose, their expressions hidden, their intent clear only to those who dare to watch.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_HUNTSMAN_DESC: The uniform of the huntsman. Worn by trackers who rely on stealth and cunning, the Vulpine Set blends into the forested ruins and overgrown fields of the Rust Belt. Its muted leathers, careful cuts, and fox pelt hat make the outfit a perfect choice for a surprise attack.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_CARTOGRAPHER_: Carried by those who chart the Belt. The Cartographer’s Set holds weathered maps, a portable sundial, and a pack built for long routes.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_SPYGLASSSET_D: Built for explorers who value observation before movement, the Spyglass Set includes tools meant for careful scouting. From rooftops and ridgelines, little goes unnoticed by a Raider equipped with this set.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_RAMPAGE_DESCR: Slam ARC to dust with this imposing sledgehammer.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_SPECKLED_DESC: This beautifully bespeckled bird will be the diamond of the flock.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_VANGUARD_DESC: For the fighters who hold the front. Heavy padding and an imposing visor give the wearer the confidence to stand at the forefront of any skirmish.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_SOLARE_DESCRI: For the Raiders who worship the sunrise. The Solare Set carries the appearance of seemingly ceremonial wear, layered with woven fabrics that evoke a time far before the arrival of ARC.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_NASCOSTO_DESC: The Nascosto’s modus operandi is simple: shoot, then disappear. A phantom on the edge of every skirmish, the only evidence they leave behind are bullet holes.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_BRIGADE_DESCR: You don’t want to find these shining blue irises waiting for you in the dark. Always caught in the crossfire, the Brigade depends on light-weight gear to stay ahead of last-second laser fire and rocket-fast rounds.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_WASPHUNTER_DE: Move like a tick, sting like a Wasp. Shroud your identity and spark fear into the hearts of Raiders with an outfit that will keep your enemies on their toes.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_RACHETTA_DESC: For Raiders who strike hard, dodge fast, and don’t care about blending in. The Rachetta's bold colors and athletic cut make no attempt at camouflage.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_CORSARO_DESCR: The Corsaro is for Raiders who are comfortable steering the ship. With a robotic arm and a spring-operated leg, any Raider who dons the Corsaro's pirate hat can feel like a techno-captain of the high seas, always dressed for conquest.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_CASTAWAY_DESC: The loner of the sea, the Castaway has long since abandoned rank and allegiance. Unpredictable and always self-reliant, the Castaway is for the Raider who can survive being left behind.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_SANDVEIL_DESC: The Sandveil's pale wraps and layered linens were made for long stretches of dust and heat, where survival depends on patience and knowing when to move, and when to stay hidden.
KeysToEntries.ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_BUNDLE_WHALER_DESCRI: Two legends of the deep sea, one weapon.

ID_PURCHASABLEOFFER_ITEMBUNDLE_ARCBACKPA.Note: This is the name of a backpack; it's made of materials salvaged from ARC
